name: mmcg
description: Mastermind Codegraph MCP server. Fast multi-language code indexer (Python, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript/JSX, Rust, C#) with 12 structural query tools: search, callers, callees (with edge_kind filter for calls/imports/inherits), impact, imports, imported_by, files, symbols_in_file, outline, recent_changes, unreferenced, api_surface. Local SQLite index, tree-sitter parsing, incremental file watcher, no system dependencies.
